name: 23111 · Mechanicsvlle, VA
findings: ZIP 23111 (Mechanicsvlle) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23111 (Mechanicsvlle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
